item.title: Supreme Court Takes Up Colorado Climate Case to Open 2026 Term
item.description: Previous Supreme Court rulings indicate interstate air and water pollution fall under federal law unless Congress explicitly provides otherwise.

item.title: Jack Smith's Conduct Fuels Push for Anti-Weaponization Fund
item.description: Documents obtained by Senate Judiciary Chair Chuck Grassley indicate Smith and associates surveilled journalists and lawmakers.

item.title: Primetime and the Taste of Televised Justice
item.description: This account of Chris Hansen's television career depicts the pursuit of online predators as an obsessive quest mirroring post-9/11 anxieties.

item.title: Supreme Court Rules on Immigration Jurisdiction
item.description: When Congress removes immigration jurisdiction from judges, that applies to all judges, including progressive activists.
